有行动暂时无法继续，请调整今天的安排。: Some actions are unavailable. Adjust today's plan to continue.
今天的行动告一段落。按自己的节奏继续，也可以让 AI 重新安排。: Today's actions are settled. Continue at your own pace or ask AI for another plan.
今天的调整不会改变长期习惯。只发送内容标题和进度摘要，不发送资料全文。: Today's changes keep your regular pace intact. Only titles and progress summaries are sent, never full materials.
练习进度按实际作答计算；完成行动不代表已经掌握。: Practice progress counts actual answers; completing an action does not establish mastery.
长期习惯单独保存。今天的调整不会改掉它。: Your regular pace is saved separately. Changes for today won't overwrite it.

例如：今天先顾考试，少安排阅读: For example: prioritize the exam today, with less reading

删除后会立刻提示，可撤销。: You can undo right after deleting.
它会从归档里消失，无法恢复。: It will disappear from the archive and cannot be recovered.
在卡片的 ⋯ 菜单里选「归档」，完成的事会收到这里。: Choose Archive in a card's ⋯ menu to keep finished work here.

点卡片上的「开始专注」才开始计时。: Click "Start focus" on a card to start timing.
